Other devices can subscribe to topics to receive the corresponding messages. An MQTT broker acts as the central server, receiving all published messages and distributing them to subscribers based on topic filters. In this project, MQTT is used to transmit feedback measurements from CHIL devices and the RSCAD power model to the SCM, and to deliver commands and set points from the SCM back to CHIL devices and RSCAD components. MQTT protocol allows for seamless integration with InfluxDB, the database tool used in this project, within the Node-RED environment. 3. InfluxDB: A time-series database developed by InfluxData, designed for efficiently storing and querying time-stamped data. In this test bed, it is used to record experimental data such as measurements from CHIL devices, RSCAD models, and control commands issued by the SCM. Data are transmitted to InfluxDB via the MQTT protocol, enabling seamless integration with other components of the communication framework. 4. Grafana: An open-source analytics and visualization platform used to create interactive dashboards, charts, and graphs. In this test bed, Grafana connects to InfluxDB to display real-time and historical data, enabling users to monitor system performance, analyze charging behavior, and track key metrics through intuitive visual interfaces.
